leads.title: Penal Code of Comoros (2020), Article 300
leads.documents: Criminalization of male and female same-sex sexual acts; penalty of six months to two years and fine of 100,000 to 300,000 francs for 'any act of a sexual nature contrary to morality or unnatural'
leads.detail: Cited in text as 'Article 300 of the 2020 Penal Code' with direct quote; no URL visible in provided text

leads.title: Penal Code of Comoros (1982)
leads.documents: Prior criminalization provision punished with up to five years imprisonment and fine of 50,000 to 1,000,000 francs
leads.detail: Cited in text as 'the 1982 Penal Code'; no URL visible in provided text

leads.title: Law No. 86-006/AF (1986), Article 5
leads.documents: Prohibition of organizations founded on an 'unlawful cause or for an unlawful purpose, contrary to the law or public morals' - cited as basis to potentially prosecute LGBTQ+ organizations; documents lack of associational rights machinery
leads.detail: Cited in text as 'Article 5 of Law No. 86-006/AF (1986)' with quoted language; no URL visible

leads.title: Code de la Famille (Family Code)
leads.documents: Non-recognition of same-sex couples; defines marriage/family as union of a man and a woman
leads.detail: Cited in text as 'The Family Code (French: Code de la Famille)' with quote 'The family considered in this code is the social structure composed of a man and a woman...'; no URL visible

leads.title: Labor Code (2012)

leads.title: U.S. Department of State 2010 Human Rights Report - Comoros
leads.documents: Societal pressure preventing public discussion of homosexual activity; absence of lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender organizations in the country
